title: Skip it
text:
Skip it. UPDATE : It started eating batteries and then the time accuracy went haywire. It would lose 6 hours in a day. Now it's in the trash. Uuuuugggghhhh!!!! A shame since it was such a handsome clock.

I kept buying hi-tech clocks but they were more of a pain than they were worth. More often than not, I'd become frustrated and dump it, then get another frustration to replace it.
Talk about stupid, right? Tons of $$$ thrown in the garbage. Just to see blinking non-correct time and the humidity in Madagascar. UUUGGHHH!
This clock is what I needed. Large face, nice TV look. Glass front. Pleasant but not loud ticking. One simple battery. What more could you ask for?

product_metadata.title: Lily's Home Vintage Retro Inspired Analog Alarm Clock, Looks Like Miniature Television Set with Silver Legs, Small Stylish Clock Adds Character to Any Bedroom, Red (5 1/2" Tall x 5 3/4" Wide)
